trigger: Independent audit found that the synthetic analyzer required mode-2 GMI support on 40% of bins but credited two streams on 100% of bins in scheduled/session accounting.
severity: promotion-blocking false-positive risk for partial-rank matrices
correction: Advance the research dataset and result schemas to v2 so v1 files cannot silently retain unconditional-stream semantics.
Require explicit per-mode active-bin masks and MCSs frozen from calibration repeats before held-out analysis.
Verify the canonical allocation JSON SHA-256 before using held-out GMI so post-freeze mask or MCS edits cannot receive rate credit.
Require mode-2 allocated bins to be a subset of mode-1 allocated bins.
Credit each mode/bin only when held-out bitwise GMI supports its frozen MCS.
Credit mode 2 only when mode 1 is also usable on that bin.
Keep unsupported allocated bins in frame airtime while assigning them zero delivered information bits.
Apply the residual recovery scalar after per-bin GMI credit instead of using it as a substitute for allocation support.
Require non-synthetic control and residual-recovery scalars to come from held-out block replay.
Compute 64 KiB and 1 MiB session rates from credited information bits per OFDM symbol, never from an unconditional two-stream multiplier.
required_regressions: A 40%-usable mode-2 fixture reports a 1.4x scheduled ceiling rather than 2.0x when mode 1 remains usable everywhere.
A partial-rank fixture with 80% usable mode 1 and 40% usable mode 2 reports a 1.2x scheduled ceiling and fails the 1.35x net-gain gate.
Held-out GMI outside the calibration-frozen mode-2 mask cannot expand the credited mask.
A post-freeze allocation mutation invalidates the allocation hash and produces no candidate session rate.
Missing frozen allocation makes candidate session goodput unavailable and cannot pass promotion.
claim_boundary: The retained-corpus decision remains STOP_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE and synthetic fixtures remain arithmetic validation only.
